$description: Siterra design tokens: base scales plus light and dark color themes. Format: DTCG 2025.10 (ADR-0029). Colors are srgb with hex; the computed OKLCH components are under $extensions.siterra.oklch. Rationale: docs/reference/design-system.md and research/design/color-system.md.

sans.$description: Interface and content. Arabic and Tifinagh glyphs fall back per character.

condensed.$description: Map labels and dense tables only

mono.$description: Record identifiers only; measured values use the sans face with tabular figures

value.$description: A single headline value with its unit

island.$description: Floating islands: sheet, case card, legend

pill.$description: Case pill, map ornament, segmented controls

ornament-button.$description: Visual size; the hit area is hit-target

stack-below.$description: Below this width the sheet becomes a bottom sheet

neutral.$description: neutral scale, light theme, OKLCH hue 80.0

6.$description: Step 6: separator: APCA Lc >= 15 on every persistent background

7.$description: Step 7: container border: OKLab-L midpoint of steps 6 and 8

8.$description: Step 8: control boundary: WCAG >= 3:1 on every persistent background

9.$description: Step 9: neutral solid and secondary icons: OKLab-L midpoint of steps 8 and 10

10.$description: Step 10: tertiary text: WCAG >= 4.5:1 and Lc >= 60 on every persistent background

11.$description: Step 11: secondary text: WCAG >= 7:1 and Lc >= 75 on every persistent background

12.$description: Step 12: primary text: Lc >= 90 on every persistent background

accent.$description: accent scale, light theme, OKLCH hue 80.0

7.$description: Step 7: tinted border: OKLab-L midpoint of steps 6 and 8

9.$description: Step 9: solid fill at the contrast threshold of its foreground (WCAG >= 4.5:1 and |Lc| >= 60)

10.$description: Step 10: solid hover: step 9 moved 0.035 in OKLab L

11.$description: Step 11: colored text: WCAG >= 4.5:1 and Lc >= 60 on every persistent and own tinted background

12.$description: Step 12: high-contrast colored text: Lc >= 90 on the default surface and own step 2

pressed.$description: Solid pressed: step 9 moved 0.07 in OKLab L away from its foreground

canvas.$description: App ground behind the map and panels

surface.$description: Opaque panels: investigation column, legend, strip

selected.$description: Selected row or item (pair with border.selected 2 px edge and a label)

control.$description: Boundaries that identify controls; >= 3:1 on every persistent background

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring, 2 px, 3 px offset

primary.$description: Primary text; APCA Lc >= 90 on every persistent background

secondary.$description: Secondary text; >= 7:1 and Lc >= 75 on every persistent background

tertiary.$description: Units, timestamps, IDs; >= 4.5:1 and Lc >= 60 on every persistent background

disabled.$description: Disabled text; below 4.5:1 by design (inactive components are exempt in WCAG 1.4.3), APCA Lc >= 30; always state the reason in words

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on interactive.default, hover and pressed

subtle-selected.$description: Selected state of subtle controls (toggle, segmented)

fg.$description: Status text and icon (pair with icon and words)
Status text and icon (pair with icon and words)
Status text and icon (pair with icon and words)
Status text and icon (pair with icon and words)

hover.$description: State layer: text.primary at alpha 0.033 over any surface; moves the surface by 1 background step(s) in OKLab L

pressed.$description: State layer: text.primary at alpha 0.064 over any surface; moves the surface by 2 background step(s) in OKLab L

ring.$description: Focus ring on solid UI surfaces

map-inner.$description: Two-tone focus over the map: inner ring (WCAG technique C40, >= 9:1 between the tones)

map-outer.$description: Two-tone focus over the map: outer ring

ndvi.$description: Raw NDVI, 7 classes low to high, fixed domain stated in the legend. cmocean speed (MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 Kristen M. Thyng), exact rows at the class centres.

ndvi-departure.$description: NDVI departure from the same-month reference: warm arm = less green than reference, green arm = greener. Custom, symmetric arms, neutral centre.

rain-departure.$description: Rainfall departure from the 1991 to 2020 same-month mean: warm arm = drier (shared with NDVI departure), blue arm = wetter. Custom.

categorical.$description: Strata or series identity: three hued slots in fixed order plus a neutral 'other' that is always dashed or patterned; never value colors

other.$description: Fourth category: neutral, always with a dash or pattern (not separable from slot 3 by color alone under CVD simulation)

no-observation-hatch.$description: No valid observation: 45 degree hatch, 1 px stroke, 6 px spacing, over the map ground; never a value color

excluded-hatch.$description: Deliberately excluded stratum: 135 degree hatch, 1 px stroke, 6 px spacing; legend states the reason

opacity.$description: Raster opacity over relief; computed minimum for class order to survive hillshade modulation is 0.83 (light NDVI)

water-line.$description: Streams and rivers; APCA Lc 30 on map.land

contour.$description: Contours; Lc 15 on map.land (founder's mineral hue)

label-halo.$description: text-halo-color for labels; WCAG treats a wide halo as the label background

outline-casing.$description: Catchment outline casing, 4.5 px under the core

context-dim.$description: Mask outside the analysis geometry (context dimmed)

outline.$description: Catchment outline core, 1.5 px; >= 9:1 against its casing (founder's mineral hue)

reference.$description: Reference line (dotted) such as the same-month median
